d: Leading private university in Kuwait is currently recruiting full-time faculty members as Assistant Professors for Human Resource Management courses to start from Spring Semester 2027.
Being an equal opportunity employer, it offers internationally competitive salaries, remuneration packages, research incentives, and professional development opportunities.

With faculty members and staff coming from more than 60 countries, it is a diverse and inclusive environment. Its campus provides cutting-edge facilities that faculty and staff can benefit from such as Sports Center, Library, Research and Innovation Center, Cultural Center, and more than 55 laboratories.
q: Faculty members are responsible for contributing to our academic programs, conducting research, and actively participating in departmental and university activities.
They are engaged in teaching, services, research, and professional development tasks.
Significantly contribute to the advancement of the research activities and publish research findings in refereed journals.
Have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and student advising at undergraduate levels.
Prepare teaching materials, maintaining and improving competence in subjects being taught.
Develop and deliver courses to students.
Prepare class activities, quizzes, assessments, and exams.
Passionately support the college and departmental-wide activities and services with a spirit of leadership, commitment, accountability, and collegiality.
Evaluate, monitor, and mentor student academic progress.
Supervise and assist students in all aspects related to the courses.
Guide, lead, and mentor students in internship and research projects.
Engage actively in promoting the growth of the university and participate in strategic activities and events.
Participate in departmental and college meetings and activities.
Serve and support functional activities of departmental committees.
Undertake any other duties as may be directed by the Head of Department.
A Ph.D. degree in Human Resource Management or a related field from an internationally accredited university.
Excellent publication records, in particular during the last five years.
Pursue academic achievements and have a demonstrable research capability.
Publish his/her research findings in refereed journals.
Have a solid commitment to teaching excellence and student advising at the undergraduate level.
Ability to work in a diverse, interdisciplinary, and fast-paced environment is essential.
Have demonstrable skills in oral and written English.

d: We are seeking an experienced Program Manager – Temenos Transact R26 to lead a large-scale, multi-country core banking transformation program for a leading wholesale banking institution in the Middle East.

The role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end implementation of Temenos Transact R26, including program governance, delivery planning, stakeholder management, budget control, resource allocation, data migration, testing and country-wise go-lives.

The ideal candidate must have a proven track record of leading full-cycle Temenos T24/Transact implementations, preferably within wholesale banking environments, and experience managing complex, cross-border transformation programs. The role requires strong executive presence, technical and functional understanding of Temenos, and the ability to lead large onsite and offshore delivery teams.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA will be an added advantage.
12–15 years of experience in banking technology delivery, including at least 6–8 years in program/project management of core banking implementations.
Mandatory experience leading at least one complete Temenos T24/Transact implementation or major upgrade , from project mobilization through go-live and hypercare.
Strong understanding of wholesale and corporate banking modules, including Corporate Lending, Syndicated Lending, Trade Finance, Payments, Cash Management and Treasury.
Experience managing large-scale, multi-country transformation programs involving multiple entities, regulatory environments and geographically distributed teams.
Proven implementation partner / system integrator experience, with responsibility for program delivery, commercial management, budget, margins and client relationships.
Strong understanding of program governance, project planning, RAID management, change control and executive-level stakeholder reporting.
Experience managing large onsite and offshore teams across multiple functional and technical workstreams.
Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior client executives.
Fluency in English is mandatory; Arabic language proficiency will be an advantage.
Willingness to be based onsite in Manama, Bahrain, for the duration of the program, with regional and international travel as required.
r: li
Lead the end-to-end delivery of the Temenos Transact R26 core banking transformation program, ensuring alignment with agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality standards.
li
Develop and manage integrated program plans, delivery strategies, resource allocation and implementation roadmaps across multiple countries.
li
Establish and oversee program governance, including steering committee meetings, design authority, change control, risk management and progress reporting.
li
Serve as the primary point of contact for client leadership, building strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders and providing regular program updates.
li
Manage cross-functional delivery teams across functional, technical, data migration and testing workstreams, ensuring effective coordination between onsite and offshore resources.
li
Oversee data migration, system integration testing, regression testing, UAT, performance testing, cutover planning and post-go-live support.
li
Drive country-wise deployment and rollout activities, ensuring alignment with local business requirements, regulatory expectations and data residency requirements.
li
Manage relationships and dependencies with Temenos, third-party vendors, system integrators and client-side teams.
li
Monitor program risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and effective mitigation strategies.
li
Manage commercial aspects of the engagement, including budgets, margins, scope changes and contractual commitments.
li
Ensure delivery quality, regulatory compliance, audit readiness and adherence to information security and data confidentiality requirements.
li
Drive continuous improvement through AI-enabled delivery practices, test automation, DevOps and process optimization.

d: Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas.
Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration.
Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app.
Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate.
Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app.
Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests.
Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar.
Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use.
Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change.
Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results.
Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment.
Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences.
Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome.
q: Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript.
A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code.
Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch.
Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment.
Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment.
Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result.
A strong eye for UI quality and polish.
A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked.
Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test.
Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool.
Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people.
Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products.
Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps.
Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.
We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
